Event

Manga Journey

You wandered into a book world and ended up as doomed villains alongside the author?! To escape this fate and return to reality, you have no other option but to try to save yourselves however you can...

Activity TypeGveMagicBookVariations2Duration7 or 8 days
Variation namesReincarnated Villainess's Manga Journey · 転生悪役令嬢のマンガの旅

GameplayEvent Rules5 sections
Basic Gameplay

◆ During the event, you can consume stamina to explore the stages. Stamina recovers automatically over time.

◆ Fly on the Grimoire to advance through the stages and defeat monsters using various classes of Elemental Magic.

◆ In-event Power = Grimoire Power + Elemental Magic Power. This stat is independent of Fellow Power outside the event.

◆ Increase Power by leveling up the Grimoire and Elemental Magic, by purchasing the event pass and Privilege Bundles, or by acquiring and improving event Fellows and Exhibits.

Grimoire

◆ The Grimoire has three attributes: ATK, HP, and DMG Reduction, which are boosted upon leveling it up. ※ATK and Elemental Magic Base DMG determine total damage. ※HP determines the Grimoire's life. ※DMG Reduction lowers damage taken from monsters by a fixed amount.

◆ Clear stages to get Magic Boost Pages for leveling up the Grimoire. The Grimoire's level resets after the event ends.

◆ The Grimoire is armed with basic Elemental Magic at the start, and it can gain 4 additional Elemental Magic skills as you explore a stage.

◆ Different Elemental Magic skills have different attack styles. You can re-select them every time you start a stage, so feel free to try them all!

◆ Purchase the Privilege Bundles to ascend your Grimoire to a super powerful version with extra attributes and unlock the exclusive skill: Invincible Magic Cannon. These benefits are valid in the current event cycle.

Elemental Magic

◆ Multiple types of Elemental Magic exist in this event. Clear specific stages to unlock them.

◆ Each Elemental Magic skill has a separate level, DMG, and cooldown duration. Leveling a magic skill up boosts its DMG and unlocks more skill modifiers at key levels.

◆ Magic skills automatically attack targets in range when their cooldown ends. Each skill has an attack range and a cooldown duration, and they can attack simultaneously.

◆ Consume Magic Boost Scrolls obtained in the stage to level up magic skills. Elemental Magic levels reset after the event ends.

Skill Modifiers

◆ Defeating monsters grants EXP and increases Exploration Level. Every time you start a stage, Exploration Level is recalculated.

◆ Increasing Exploration Level unlocks new Skill Modifiers, which activate new Elemental Magic skills and can be used to improve the existing ones.

◆ You can also get Skill Modifiers by defeating monsters to free the people trapped in cages.

◆ Skill Modifiers have prerequisites. You must obtain earlier modifiers to unlock advanced ones.

◆ Each Elemental Magic skill has an ultimate modifier that drastically increases its power.

◆ All Skill Modifiers can be viewed in the Compendium.

Leaderboard and Rewards

◆ The Reincarnated Villainess's Manga Journey event features both overall rankings and daily rankings.

◆ Daily rankings are based on the stamina consumed daily by individual players and guilds.

◆ Overall rankings are finalized at the end of the event. The Individual Overall Ranking is based on the highest chapter completed by individual players, and the Guild Overall Ranking is based on the total stamina consumed by guilds (the sum of consumption by all members of a guild).

◆ When leaderboard results are finalized, you can claim rewards based on your ranking position.

◆ Any unclaimed rewards will be delivered via the in-game mail.
